title: CRLR/190/2020 of SANDEEP SINGH RAWAT Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
CRLR No. 190 of 2020
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. Lokendra Dobhal, Advocate for the
revisionist.
Mr. Pratiroop Pandey, AGA for the State.
This matter is heard through Video
Conferencing.
Instant revision has been preferred against the
order dated 08.01.2019, passed in Case No. 397 of
2017, Smt. Nikita Rana Vs. Sandeep Singh Rawat, by
the court of learned Principal Judge, Family Court,
Dehradun (for short "the case"). By the impugned
order, the revisionist has been directed to pay
Rs.7000/- per month, as an interim maintenance to the
respondent no. 2 Nikita Rana.
Learned counsel for the revisionist would
submit that parties have settled their dispute; it was a
matrimonial dispute; a petition for divorce on mutual
consent has already been moved before the court of
competent jurisdiction in the month of February,
2020, which may be taken up sometime in near future.
Therefore, now the revisionist does not want to press
this revision and it has now become infructuous.
The instant revision has yet not been admitted.
Had it been admitted, there would have been no other
option but to decide it on merit. But, since the
revision has yet not been admitted and learned
counsel for the revisionist does not press it now,
hence, it deserves rejection, as not pressed.
The revision is dismissed as not pressed.
